summary: LXP Industrial Trust filed an 8-K announcing a definitive merger agreement to be acquired by Leopard REIT LLC, a vehicle controlled by an unnamed parent, in a going-private transaction. Each common share will be cancelled and converted into the right to receive cash, though exact per-share price, premium, and implied value are not disclosed in this excerpt. The board unanimously approved the merger and recommends common shareholder approval at a special meeting. Series C preferred shares remain outstanding. The transaction is subject to shareholder vote, regulatory approvals, and customary closing conditions. The acquiring entity is a newly formed LLC, suggesting sponsor-backed take-private. Watch for financing details and shareholder vote timeline; risk-arb spread depends on disclosed consideration.
